map.1: Damages squads in its line of fire, including your own. Be sure to place it wisely.
map.2: Targets an individual squad, causing some serious damage.
map.3: Causes damage to all squads within its blast radius, including your own.
map.4: Distracts nearby squads from their orders. It also affects your squads, so beware.
map.5: Stops squads in their tracks by placing obstacles. It also affects your squads.
